summary: GigaCloud Technology Inc. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 financial results and announcing a new share repurchase program. The Board approved repurchases of Class A ordinary shares up to $120.0 million, effective August 6, 2026, for three years, terminating the prior 2025 program. Repurchases may occur via open market, private negotiations, or block trades, compliant with Rule 10b5-1 and 10b-18. Timing and amount depend on price, volume, market conditions, and working capital needs. Watch for execution pace and potential EPS support.
